raw_affiliation_strings: Mike Solly is Senior Lecturer in Education at the Open University, United Kingdom, and is working on ‘English in action’, a large-scale ELT development project. He worked in ELT as a teacher and trainer in Eastern Europe, the Middle East, and the United Kingdom for more than 15 years and, for the past ten years, has been involved in the management and delivery of a number of ELT projects. He was coordinator of the IATEFL Global Issues Special Interest Group (SIG) and has a growing interest in ELT in development and mobile technologies. He is currently researching the potential advantages of learning English for Bangladeshi workers migrating to the Middle East
